title: cargo-codemap trace close event
description: One JSON-Lines record for a span's own CLOSE event -- structurally identical to trace-entry.schema.json except for `fields` (a fixed "close" marker plus the two duration strings tracing_subscriber adds) -- emitted once, when that span exits. See trace-entry.schema.json's own description for why there is no 'formatVersion' field.

fields.description: Fixed "close" marker plus the two duration strings tracing_subscriber's FmtSpan::CLOSE adds on its own -- distinct from an entry event's fields, which are always just {"message": "new"}.

time.busy.description: How long this specific occurrence of the span was actually executing, as a human-readable duration string ("1.23ms", "450\u00b5s"/"450us", "2.1s", "900ns"). This is what trace_log.py's iteration count and per-call duration come from -- see parse_duration().

time.idle.description: How long the span existed but wasn't the active one (e.g. while a child span was running instead). Always present in real output but not read by trace_log.py today -- documented for completeness.

filename.description: Same field, same meaning, as trace-entry.schema.json's filename -- a close event carries the same location its own entry event did.

threadId.description: Same field, same meaning, as trace-entry.schema.json's threadId -- a close event carries the same thread id its own entry event did.
